pa_labels.PA1: the response to a part of a scene sitting inside its surround
pa_labels.PA2: how far a location is held back as the surround implies the part
pa_labels.PA3: which grain of agreement a location answers to

scoring: each criterion is a skill score on its own quantity, 1 for the recording reproduced and 0 for no closer than the closest answer that needs no mechanism, held inside 0 and 1 and averaged over the submitted and the refit run; the predictive accuracy is the mean of the criteria

target.note: the better on each criterion of two linear rules over the same columns, each shared by every location, one fitted on how the response changes between the test settings and one fitted to every criterion at once, both on the test settings themselves and scored the way a submission is

C3.value: 0.01983 from the part, 0.02068 from the surround

C4.value: 55.0% of what is left once each location's own level is out

D1.value: 14.14% of the response per unit agreement

E1.value: adding the two PA 0.000, copying the surround PA 0.000, copying the part PA 0.000, target PA 0.376
